name: Sick (feverish)
description: Generic illness state. Apply with [state <char> -> sick]. Layers fever, chills and weakness onto the character; overlays append to existing anatomy prose.

properties.affect_summary: Sick — feverish and weak, mind foggy. Hot and shivery at once, low on energy, just wanting to lie down.
properties.mannerism_overlay: Shivers despite the warmth, wraps her arms around herself, sniffles and coughs, moves slowly and gingerly, voice thick and nasal.

body_overlays.head: Her face is flushed with fever and sheened in a faint sweat, eyes glassy and over-bright, nose red and raw; damp strands of hair stick to her forehead.
body_overlays.arms: Her arms are wrapped around herself against the chills running through her.
